studio.app.blocked.not_streamer: You're not a Sini streamer yet. You can still set up your scenes.
studio.app.blocked.signed_out: Your session ended. Sign in again to go live.

studio.app.link.title: Sign in to Sini Live Studio
studio.app.link.waiting: Finish in the browser that opened, then press Connect.

studio.app.orientationLocked: Orientation can't be changed while live.

studio.app.perf.failed: Couldn't load stream performance yet. The studio will try again automatically.
studio.app.perf.title: LIVE performance
studio.app.prop.name: Name
studio.app.quitBody: Closing Sini Live Studio will end your broadcast.
studio.app.sceneFull: A scene can have up to 20 sources.
studio.app.signOutLive: End your broadcast before signing out.
studio.app.titleLocked: Title and category can't be changed while live.
studio.app.uiInfo.camera: Show yourself from a webcam or a camera connected to your computer.
studio.app.uiInfo.captureCard: Stream a console or pro camera through a capture card. Choose your capture card in the next step.
studio.app.uiInfo.desktopAudio: Everything your computer plays — games, music, videos. Notification sounds are included too.
studio.app.uiInfo.game: Captures the game you're playing on this computer. If it isn't captured, run the game in full screen or use Screen capture instead.
studio.app.uiInfo.image: Show an image — your channel logo, a frame, or a background.
studio.app.uiInfo.link: Show a web page from an https:// address — a scoreboard or a widget, for example. It runs separately and can't access your Sini account.
studio.app.uiInfo.mic: Your voice from a microphone. Adjust its volume in the bar below the preview.
studio.app.uiInfo.screen: Show a whole monitor — good for presentations, tutorials, or games that can't be captured.
studio.app.uiInfo.text: Put text on screen — a schedule, a call to action, or a guest's name.
studio.app.uiInfo.video: Play a video file from your computer — an intro, a break screen, or a clip. It loops.
studio.app.uiInfo.w_alert: Incoming gifts appear on screen with the sender's name, an animation and a sound.
studio.app.uiInfo.w_chatbox: The latest chat messages on your video, including gifts and new followers.
studio.app.uiInfo.w_countdown: A countdown you start, pause and reset from the studio.
studio.app.uiInfo.w_counter: A titled number you change yourself with +1 and −1.
studio.app.uiInfo.w_goal: A progress bar for gift coins, gift count, new followers or new members in this stream.
studio.app.uiInfo.w_ranking: Viewers who sent the most gifts in this stream, updated as gifts arrive.
studio.app.uiInfo.window: Show just one app window, without notifications or other windows on your screen.
studio.app.welcome.body: Go live from your computer, straight to your viewers on Sini.
studio.app.welcome.legal: By continuing, you agree to Sini's {terms} and {privacy}.
studio.app.welcome.title: Welcome to Live Studio
studio.app.widget.goalHint: Counted for the current stream; starts from 0 each new stream.
studio.app.widget.soundHint: Set the sound volume in the mixer.
studio.app.widget.testHint: Sends a sample to this widget only; nothing is posted to Sini.
studio.app.widget.title: Title
studio.app.widget.titleHint: Leave empty for the default title.
studio.app.widget.unavailable: Widgets can't load on the stream screen. Close and reopen Sini Live Studio.
